options.name: Light glass
options.summary: Bright iOS-style liquid glass: a frosted, see-through card floating over a soft pastel wallpaper, glass capsule input and Add button, iOS-blue round checkboxes, progress ring.

options.name: Dark glass
options.summary: Night-mode liquid glass: smoky translucent panels over a deep, glowing wallpaper; every task is its own floating glass capsule; progress bar under the title.

options.name: iOS Reminders style
options.summary: Feels like an iPhone app: big left-aligned title, inset grouped list, and the input lives in a floating glass bar pinned to the bottom like an iOS toolbar.
